concept: Stateless web tier: offload sessions to ElastiCache/DynamoDB
tests: Where to store sessions for a horizontally scaled fleet so they survive server replacement.
expected: Amazon ElastiCache for Redis as a shared in-memory session store: low latency, survives instance replacement. Triggers: "session state", "horizontally scaled", "server is replaced", "low-latency shared".
why_not: Local disk and EBS are tied to the instance and get lost; sticky sessions without an external store break when a target is removed.
